concept: Search a concept in lecture recordings and jump to its timestamped explanation.

sources.title: Original SayWhat? pitch deck, 14 slides and speaker notes
sources.observed: Speech recognition, text indexing, concept keywords and timestamp navigation across lecture recordings. Original UI uses emerald and charcoal, a lecture library, waveform and the search term persona.

sources.title: Local hackathon catalog
sources.observed: SayWhat, Edu-Tech Hackathon 2017, NUS. No linked source repository.

interpretation: Contemporary lecture-search studio inspired by the original deck. The 35-minute recording, transcript, lecture titles and three timestamps are illustrative. Playback is a visual demonstration; no audio recording is loaded. This does not claim the original prototype was deployed.
motion: 28-second deterministic sequence: capture lecture, type persona, reveal three timestamp matches, seek to 14:28, play the matched passage, fade and restart. Screen and physical waveform share one timing state. Shared pause, reset and reduced-motion support retained.
materials: Ivory stone plinth, satin brass, jade waveform, microphone grille, leather headphone cushions and paper notebook. Instanced waveform bars and batched static geometry.
card: Standard artwork/3D tabs, reset and pause controls with one short caption. No custom walkthrough panel.
